name: Twin towers
kicker: The Cham pair inside the city
summary: Late-12th-century Cham pair in the city: walk both brick towers on a two-hour visit, for 20,000 đồng. Each tower has a square body and a curved top, with Garuda figures at the corners. The pair was ranked an architecture-and-art relic in 1980. Tháp Bánh Ít is the four-tower hill about 20 km away.
getThere: Inside the city, in phường Đống Đa.
heroCaption: Both towers, tops and bases, in daylight
body: Walk the two towers in the city. They date from the late 12th century, and they are also called Tháp Hưng Thạnh. Each one has a square body under a curved top, with Garuda figures at the corners and pointed arches over the doors. The Ministry of Culture and Information ranked the pair an architecture-and-art relic in 1980.

The address line reads Phường Quy Nhơn. The description places the towers in phường Đống Đa. Either line keeps you inside the city, a ride from the beach. The posted visit is two hours, the ticket is 20,000 đồng, and the hours run from 7:00 to 18:00. Tháp Bánh Ít is the four-tower group on a hill about 20 km away, beside Highway 1.
